name: WholeStock – Wholesale & Inventory Management
author: Wpfinity

sections.description:
WholeStock is a complete wholesale and warehouse management system built for import-based product businesses. Manage your entire inventory pipeline from incoming shipments to customer sales orders, all from within WordPress.

Core Features (Lite):

  • Products — Create a product catalog with flexible multi-unit conversions (e.g., cartons, dozens, boxes → individual pieces).
  • Shipments — Track incoming inventory shipments with line items, carton counts, and per-unit costs in any supported unit.
  • Customers — Manage customer profiles with lifetime due tracking and order history.
  • Sales Orders — Create orders drawn from specific shipment batches with full stock validation and status workflow (pending → confirmed → delivered).
  • Payments — Record payments against orders with automatic status tracking (unpaid/partial/paid).
  • Stock View — Real-time inventory at the shipment-item level with batch traceability.
  • Audit Logs — Track every action with user, timestamp, and before/after values.
  • Invoices — Public or private invoice URLs with print and PDF download support.
  • Currency — Select from 40+ world currencies with customizable formatting.
  • Settings — Business info, number prefixes, invoice configuration, and more.

Source Code & Build

The uncompiled Vue 3 source code for the admin interface is included in the frontend/ directory.

To build the production assets from source:
1. Navigate to the frontend/ directory: cd frontend
2. Install dependencies: npm install
3. Run the build script: npm run build

Output assets will be generated in assets/dist/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload wholestock to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘WholeStock’ menu in wp-admin to get started.
  4. Configure your business info and currency in Settings.
sections.faq:
What PHP version is required?

PHP 8.0 or higher is required.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

WooCommerce integration is planned for an upcoming release.

Can I use custom units?

Yes! Each product can define its own unit conversions (e.g., 1 carton = 24 pcs).
